How I work — clear values, clear boundaries

Evidence-informed, person-centered

I combine empirically supported methods with clinical judgment and your lived expertise. Treatment is tailored, collaborative, and time-limited when appropriate.

Confidential and direct

Sessions are private. I’ll be transparent about limits of confidentiality, my record-keeping, and how we handle communication between sessions.

Practical change

We track goals and skills. Expect actionable tools you can use between sessions and language to improve relationships and workplace functioning.

Approaches I bring to the session

Flexible use of therapies to match your needs.

Trauma-informed CBT

Structured work on thoughts and behaviors while we honor nervous system responses and pacing.

Relational and attachment work

We explore patterns in relationships and build new ways to connect and set limits.

Mindfulness & somatic tools

Grounding, breath work, and interoceptive practice to regulate stress and support lasting change.

Executive coaching elements

Organizational and communication strategies to reduce burnout and sharpen decision-making.

Modalities are adapted to your goals. They do not guarantee outcomes and are not emergency services.

Common questions people have before starting

Is therapy confidential?

Yes — except when there is risk of harm to self or others, or as otherwise required by law. We discuss the limits of confidentiality at intake.

Will I have to talk about my childhood?

Only as it helps your present goals. We work at a pace you can tolerate and focus on practical, present-day change.

What if I only need a few sessions?

Short-term or goal-focused work is welcome. We co-design the length and frequency of care based on progress and need.

Can you help with work-related stress?

Yes. I offer strategies for stress management, boundaries, and communication — within the boundaries of clinical practice (not workplace mediation).

Client reflections

"Practical tools and a calm space — I learned to manage my anxiety without feeling overwhelmed." — E., mid-career professional
"We worked on communication with my partner in a way that finally felt safe and useful." — L., 30s

Download: 5-step grounding guide

Short practices you can use during stressful moments. No cost — immediate PDF delivered to your inbox.

Ready to begin?

Schedule a 20-minute consultation to see if we’re a good fit.
